terms.name: Governability
terms.definition: A property of a consequential process describing the extent to which legitimate parties can understand, influence, constrain, correct, or recover its operation and outcomes. It does not imply complete predictability or a single controller.

terms.name: Meaningful human control
terms.definition: A condition in which people retain adequate information, independent judgment, authority, and practical means to redirect consequential activity. A nominal human-in-the-loop approval does not, by itself, demonstrate this capacity.

terms.name: Operational trust
terms.definition: Reliance placed in an AI-enabled capability through actual use, decisions, and delegation, whether or not users express subjective confidence in it. Trust in this sense is operational behavior, not a reliability certification.
